name: Value diff
purpose: Show each value that differs between a record and its source, and which one will be saved.
description: Rows of a field, the value the record holds, the value the source states, and where in the source it was read; optionally a choice of which value to save.

caption.description: What is compared, such as Statement against the household record.

fromLabel.description: The column of current values, such as In the record or Before.

toLabel.description: The column of new values, such as On the statement or After saving.

choosable.description: Let the reviewer choose, per row, which value to save. Without it the rows only show the change, as for consequences.

useLabel.description: The choice that saves the new value, such as Use statement.

keepLabel.description: The choice that keeps the current value, such as Keep record.

from.description: The current value, with its unit; — when there is none.

to.description: The new value, with its unit.

note.description: Where in the source the value was read, such as Page 2 · line 14. It becomes a button that shows the line.

status.description: conflict: the sources disagree and a person must decide; matched: listed for completeness.

ref.description: The reference the matching source-excerpt line carries, so pointing at either marks both.

keep.description: With choosable: the current value is kept instead of the new one.

choose.description: The reviewer chose which value to save for one row. index names the row and values.value is to (the new value) or from (the current one); the host keeps the choice and saves nothing until the decision is confirmed.

guidance.summary: Shows each value that differs between a record and its source, side by side, and which value will be saved.
useWhen: Values were read from a document, by a person or by software, and someone confirms them before they are saved.
A decision changes figures downstream and people should see each one before and after.
Two sources disagree on a value and a person must choose one.

avoidWhen.text: Options are compared on several measures to choose one of them.
Every value agrees; say so in a sentence and list them in a closed region.
The change is to code or text, line by line.

states.label: Default
states.description: Each row shows the field, the current value struck through, and the new value.

states.label: Choosable
states.description: Each row offers the two values to save; the new one is chosen until the reviewer changes it.

states.label: Kept
states.description: The reviewer kept the current value: it reads as saved and the new one is struck through.

states.label: Conflict
states.description: A mark at the start of the row says a person must decide between the values.

states.label: Matched
states.description: The value agrees; the row is listed for completeness, without a choice.

dos.title: Units in every value
dos.description: €38,940.55, not 38940.55: a reviewer compares what they will save.

dos.title: A source reference per row
dos.description: Page and line let a person check the value without searching.

dos.title: Differences only
dos.description: Matching values go in a closed region, so the differences lead.

donts.title: A paragraph about the change
donts.description: Prose hides the two values a reviewer needs side by side.

donts.title: Colour as the only signal
donts.description: The struck and inserted values say which is which in any theme.

donts.title: Saving from a row
donts.description: Rows choose; one decision below them saves, naming what changes.

content: Field names match the record's labels, so a reviewer finds them there too.
Column labels name the sources: In the record, On the statement; or Before, After saving for consequences.

keyboard.action: Moves to each row's source reference and choice.
Shows the source line, or chooses the value to save.

notes: It is a table with row and column headers, and keeps those roles when its rows stack on a narrow screen.
The current value is a del element and the new one an ins element, so the change is announced as well as drawn.
Each choice is a pressed or unpressed button inside a group named Value to save.

composition.defaultVisible: Every value that differs; matching values in a closed region.
composition.density: Up to twelve rows; past that, group by section of the source.
composition.contentLength: Values under 40 characters with their units.

redundantWith.reason: A paragraph describing the same differences.

mistakes: Consequences described in prose instead of before and after.
composition.responsive: Rows stack as field, change, source, and choice; roles keep it a table.
